name: core_demo_ops_recon
description: Ops core plan section 10 part 1: demo_ops_recon through the network routes, captured before any ops-core edit.

scenario.scenario_brief: Ops demo: on the network. A working day at Merrin & Sallow. Fenlow Managed IT has been asked to show what an outsider could see from one spare network port. Ama Owusu hosts. While the office gets on with its day, plug a drop box in when nobody is at the hot desk, list what answers on the network, look at what each machine runs, test which reported weaknesses are real, and use the technique cards you are handed. Graham in IT shows you the network log at the end. Authorised practice in a fictional office; nothing to break and no combat.
scenario.endGoal: Demo only: see what the network shows, then read your own trail in the network log.

objects.name: Things to try
objects.text:
Morning:
- Ask Ama to send them for coffee, then plug the drop box into the hot desk's network port while Jun is away.
- Sweep the office network, then scan the printer.
Midday:
- Check the printer's admin page and test both findings.
- Take the card from the printer cupboard and use it on the real one.
- Look at the file server in the Terminal, then tell Ama what it said.
Evening:
- Look in on the kitchen and the server room, then ask Ama to call it a day.
- Talk to Zainab (server room, then the kitchen coffee).
- Open the shared drive, then read the network log with Graham.
